user_story: As a mobile customer, I want the Sauce Demo store at https://www.saucedemo.com to remain usable on a small screen so that I can shop from my phone. Acceptance criteria: with the viewport set to 375x812 (mobile portrait), logging in with 'standard_user' / 'secret_sauce' shows the inventory page; the burger menu button '#react-burger-menu-btn' is visible at this viewport and clicking it opens the side menu container '.bm-menu' with the logout link '#logout_sidebar_link' visible inside it.
